routes.title: TapTest — Typing Speed Test
routes.description: Find out how fast you really type. TapTest times you on real prose, not scrambled word lists, and measures your WPM and accuracy. No account needed.

routes.title: Start a Typing Test — TapTest
routes.description: Set up your typing test: pick 1, 2 or 5 minutes and an easy, medium or hard passage, then start typing. Free, and no sign-up required.

routes.title: Typing Speed Test — TapTest
routes.description: Take a timed typing speed test on real English prose. TapTest shows your WPM, characters per minute and accuracy live as you type.

routes.title: About TapTest — Typing Speed Test
routes.description: Why TapTest uses real sentences instead of scrambled word lists, and how its three difficulty levels are graded by average word length.

routes.title: Contact — TapTest
routes.description: Get in touch with TapTest. Email us about a bug, a passage that reads wrong, or anything else, or send feedback straight from the site.

routes.title: Privacy Policy — TapTest
routes.description: How TapTest handles your data: what is collected when you take a typing test or create an account, how it is stored, and how to have it deleted.

routes.title: Terms of Service — TapTest
routes.description: The terms you agree to when you use TapTest: acceptable use, accounts, intellectual property and the limits of our liability.

routes.title: Race a Friend — TapTest Typing Test
routes.description: Race a friend at typing. Share a room code, both type the same passage, and watch each other's speed update live. Free on TapTest.

routes.title: Sign In — TapTest
routes.description: Sign in to TapTest to save your typing test results and track your progress over time.

routes.title: Create an Account — TapTest
routes.description: Create a free TapTest account to keep a history of your typing tests and watch your WPM improve.

routes.title: Your Profile — TapTest
routes.description: Your TapTest profile: your typing test history, your best WPM and accuracy, and how your speed has changed.
